comment: Microalbuminuria was a documented prior finding ("microalbuminuria de 50 mg/12 h"), but it is a timed excretion, not an ACR, so no legible CAC value exists and null is right. Unsure: the code could arguably be expected to read 50 mg/12 h.
The ACR was done and has a legible value: "índice microalbuminuria/creatininuria de 261,9 mg/g"; the code read none.
The patient refused another immunosuppressant, not a test: "rechazo del paciente a otro tratamiento inmunosupresor".

Daily haemodialysis patient with prior nephrology follow-up ("iniciando seguimiento nefrológico hasta los 41 años") and joint inpatient management "valorado conjuntamente con el servicio de nefrología"; a GP would treat her as under Nephrology. Unsure because the sentence alone is an inpatient co-assessment.
The test was done with a legible value, "FG (T) 70,67 ml/min/1,73 m2"; code value 70.67 matches (unit left empty, FG(SC) 50,02 also reported). Unsure about the missing unit and the two FG values.
Referred for follow-up and then enrolled in chronic haemodialysis: "derivada a Consultas de Nefrología para seguimiento", "incluye en programa de hemodiálisis crónica".
eGFR was reported with a legible value: "FGe MDRD 34ml/min/1,73m2"; the code read no value.
One-off inpatient consult with no ongoing follow-up: "valorado por el Servicio de Nefrología, instaurándose tratamiento con furosemida"; the patient died 5 months later.
Explicit ongoing follow-up: "Se mantuvo en seguimiento en policlínico de infectología y nefrología".
Referred, then chronic kidney disease managed by the unit: "conocida en nuestra unidad desde 2008", "controlada de forma ambulatoria", on dialysis; a GP would count her as under Nephrology.
Single inpatient assessment during a terminal admission: "Tras valoración por el Servicio de Nefrología, se inició tratamiento con diálisis"; no follow-up, patient died.

Only a referral for proteinuria ("La envían a Nefrología por detectar proteinuria de +++"); ongoing Nephrology follow-up is never stated, though renal biopsy and 12 months of follow-up suggest it. Unsure.
Explicit ongoing follow-up: "Es seguida por el servicio de nefrología por el empeoramiento de la función renal", later haemodialysis and transplant.

Acute kidney injury in a hospitalised patient with a single haemodialysis session: "Nefrología confirma diagnóstico de insuficiencia renal aguda"; discharged with normal renal function and "niega antecedente de enfermedad renal".
Ongoing specialist follow-up of Gitelman syndrome: "Se controló en consultas de Nefrología Pediátrica", with continued treatment.
The ACR was done with a legible value: "Cociente albúmina/creatinina: 0,6µg/mgr"; the code read none.
Nephrology referral in 2009 with no continuing follow-up: "deja de acudir a las consultas de nefrología" the same year.
Current follow-up is explicit: "se mantiene en control en el policlínico de nefrología de nuestro hospital, con hemodiálisis trisemanal".
The sentence is an author affiliation line ("Instituto de Nefrología"), not a statement about the patient; the body only says "Control nefrológico: creatinina 1,56 mg/dl". Unsure.
Explicit ongoing follow-up: "está bajo control y seguimiento por el Servicio de Nefrología".
